utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Got it — Sunday at the community center, and I’ll make sure the drop-off times and parts are clearly labeled.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Hana — that would really help keep things organized. I’m relieved we’ve got the timing and labels sorted.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yep, I can help with the Sunday repair drive at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That’s great, Rey—thanks! I’ll keep passing the word that it’s Sunday at the community center, and any extra hands will be a big help.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Mara — I’m happy to bring my tools and lend a hand at the Sunday drive at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Gus — that’s a big help. If you can check what still needs doing when you get there, I’d really appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Kira — Sunday at the community center is the plan now, and I’d really appreciate help lining up a few volunteers.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just confirming — you want me to help line up volunteers for Sunday at the community center, right?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’ve only heard bits and pieces—what’s the latest on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: It’s moved to Sunday at the community center now. I’m keeping it low-key and trying to stay organized—sorry, my brain’s a bit foggy today.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll keep spreading the word about the Sunday repair drive at the community center and try to line up a few more volunteers.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Quinn — that’d be a huge help. I’m happy to take on any remaining tasks or fill in wherever you need me.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sure — I’ll keep it low-key and let folks know the repair drive is Sunday at the community center, and I can help line up a few volunteers.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh good, thanks — I’m still catching up, so I’m not sure what’s left. If there’s a list, I can help with a few pieces.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Right, it’s Sunday at the community center now. I can help with sorting if you need it.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Leo — I can check what supplies we already have and what’s still needed, then we can sort it out together.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good, Cleo. Once you check the list, let me know what’s still needed and I’ll keep an eye out for the Sunday setup at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Will do — I’ll check the supplies list and tell you what’s still missing.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Opal — Sunday at the community center works better for me. Keep it low-key, and I can help a little.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great, I’ll keep it low-key and confirm the repair drive is set for Sunday at the community center. I’ll also check what supplies we still need and let you know.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I can label the boxes and keep the parts sorted by drop-off time.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Good, that helps. What else still needs doing?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late again — what’s still left to do for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Not much left — we’re set for Sunday at the community center, and I’m still gathering a few more tools and spare parts. If you can, a hand with volunteers would be great.
